title: This Haunted Texas Hotel Video Has Us Asking Questions
excerpt: A red rope appears to move with no one visibly touching it at the Historic Jefferson Hotel. Ghostly encounter or another explanation? You decide.
content:
A video from the Historic Jefferson Hotel in Jefferson, Texas, appears to show a red rope moving when no one is visible nearby. I've never been much of a ghost believer. I'm one of those people who needs to see something with my own eyes before I'm convinced. But this creepy clip has me questioning what I thought I knew about the paranormal.

The Historic Jefferson Hotel Has a Spooky Past

If you’re not very familiar with The Jefferson Hotel, is it very well known as it has been around for 170 years and offered visitors a place to stay for 100 of those years. According to their own website the hotel offers an eclectic collection of antiques and whispers of specters roaming the halls. The building was first a cotton warehouse in the 1850s, it also once served as a brothel with ‘good time girls.’

READ MORE: A Ghost Screamed at a Cross at the Jefferson Hotel

A Doll Moves, and a Hotel Owner Feels a Tug

If you have some time, you should check out the YouTube channel set up for The Historic Jefferson Hotel it shows you numerous videos of unexplained sightings or things moving around within the hotel. Some of the most unusual videos recently have been about a doll moving on its own and the owner of the hotel having his shirt tugged on.

Watch the Red Rope Move in This Haunted Hotel Video

The video below from the haunted hotel shows a red rope that is moving on its own. You see no one around the rope at the time when it begins to move. The owner thinks it looks like someone went under the rope, to me I just see it moving a lot. But regardless, I don’t see anyone around that could have moved the rope.
